effect.name: GM Timeslice Warp
effect.desc: A mask that behaves like waving cloth. Pick a slice shape - a horizontal band, a vertical band, a ring, a diagonal band, a slice that travels on its own, or a blob - and the boundary of that mask is itself pushed around by a cloth field, so the edge ripples and folds instead of staying a straight line. Inside the mask the layer is displaced along the same field, with a gravity term so the wave hangs the way fabric does, and a fold highlight that tracks the crests. Mask position, width, edge softness, invert, cloth amplitude, frequency, speed, wind, hang, folds, sharpness and turbulence are all separate.
